newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee futures in slim gains, ignore NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee futures in slim gains, ignore NY.

text.p: LIFFE robusta coffee futures posted slim gains by Friday midsession with the market failing to move in tandem with sky-rocketing New York-listed arabica values.
"They are two different markets, each pulling in a different direction," said one said.
London was called a hefty $100-$120 higher on numbers after Thursday's dazzling rally in New York. But it managed to gap just $29 at the open, basis July.
By the midday recess, the benchmark contract added just $2 at $1,662 after an intraday high of $1,990.
Traders said the contract's persistent failure to break above the $1,705 resistance reflected large overhanging producer sales.
Industry is well-stocked of robustas while funds would stay out unless July heads towards $1,720.
Overall volume totalled 1,137 lots. July/September switches were traded at $8-10 and May/July saw bids at $90 and offers at $75.
Traders said New York's July which has risen by over 16 percent in a week is now set to make an assault at 240 cents a lb, to be followed by 260.
On Thursday, it closed 12.50 up at 224.90 cents after vaulting to a new contract high of 224.

On the fundamental news, German roaster Tchibo Frisch-Roest Kaffee said on Friday it has raised its retail prices by up to one mark per 500 grams with immediate effect. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
